_comment: What outsiders may edit in this game, and in this game's own words.
Without this file the Meckie contribution tools had Ziggy's baked into
them — beat names, directory layout, probe paths, even 'the power goes
out'. Install a different Godot game and every one of those was wrong.
The platform enforces; the GAME declares. A repo with no contrib.json
simply gets no Write button, which is honest — better than offering
`kind` selects which builder the platform uses. Two exist: 'character'
(a person with lines grouped by beat) and 'chapter' (a scripted
evening). A game says which it has, where they live, and what its

toggles.label: the power goes out partway through
